Setup Instructions

How to Install Rebound

Quick step-by-step guides for installing Rebound on Windows and Android devices.

🪟 Windows Setup Guide ▼
  1. Click Download Windows above to download the installer package.
  2. Double click the downloaded Rebound-Setup-v1.0.2.exe file.
  3. If Windows SmartScreen displays "Unknown Publisher", click More Info and select Run Anyway.
  4. Rebound will launch instantly and place a shortcut on your desktop!
🤖 Android APK Setup Guide ▼
  1. Download Rebound-v1.0.2-test.apk directly on your phone or scan the QR code above.
  2. Open your phone's Downloads folder and tap the APK file.
  3. If prompted by Android, enable "Allow installation from unknown sources" for your browser or file manager.
  4. Tap Install. Once complete, tap Open to start planning!
